title: Sound cues: which BOOM Library file each battle or menu cue's takes are cut from (SPEC §16.1, §17)

source.pattern: ^((Medieval Weapons|Close Combat|Creature Foley|Magic|Magic - Arcane Forces|Free Sounds - Death Whistle)( - (Designed|Construction Kit))?/.+\.wav|synth:dice)$

peak.description: A menu cue's takes are matched by their loudest point to this many dBFS, not by loudness (a click is too short to measure); absent, battle cues are matched to -16 LUFS.
